changelog: v3.17.55 / v3.9.51: premium cinematic startup animation — full-screen brand intro on cold launch (landscape on TV/Fire TV, portrait on phone), packaged locally (works offline), skip on OK/Select or tap, static-logo fallback if the video cannot play, warm launches never replay it. New neon AJO logo across launcher icons, adaptive icons, TV banner and splash on all variants. Also carries the v3.17.54 embed playback-started watchdog fix.
